name: Pope Leo X
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 1513 to 1521
contribution: Head of the Catholic Church and leader of the Papal States from 9 March 1513 to his death in December 1521.

checks.lead: Pope Leo X (Italian: Leone X; born Giovanni di Lorenzo de' Medici, 11 December 1475 – 1 December 1521) was head of the Catholic Church and leader of the Papal States from 9 March 1513 to his death in December 1521.
